【原视频简介】
The classic two-faced thionine experiment is a visual demonstration of a reaction that begins when the solution absorbs light energy. Discover a variation of this favourite practical that uses methylene blue instead of thionine to make the effects easier to observe and more engaging for learners. 

Watch the video and download the technician notes for a kit list, tips and safety information from the Education in Chemistry website: https://rsc.li/4xgAeuM
